title: Cohomology and tensor invariance on a finite scheme
statement: Let $k$ be a field, let $A$ be a finite-dimensional $k$-algebra [def-weil-finite-dimensional-subspace] [def-weil-vector-space-dimension], let $T=\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ [def-pc-scheme], let $\mathcal G$ be a coherent $\mathcal O_T$-module [pqf-def-coherent], and let $\mathcal L$ be an invertible $\mathcal O_T$-module [def-sc-invertible-module]. Then $H^q(T,\mathcal G)=0$ and $H^q(T,\mathcal G\otimes_{\mathcal O_T}\mathcal L)=0$ for every $q>0$, both $\Gamma(T,\mathcal G)$ and $\Gamma(T,\mathcal G\otimes\mathcal L)$ are finite-dimensional $k$-vector spaces, and $\dim_k\Gamma(T,\mathcal G\otimes\mathcal L)=\dim_k\Gamma(T,\mathcal G)$. Consequently, the Euler characteristics of [def-pc-euler-characteristic] are defined and satisfy $\chi(T,\mathcal G)=\dim_k\Gamma(T,\mathcal G)$ and $\chi(T,\mathcal G\otimes\mathcal L)=\chi(T,\mathcal G)$.
